options.content:
### SINGLE-SERVER DIAGNOSTICS · CPU / RAM / GPU / DISK / NETWORK / PING  
[← Back to **Fleet Overview**](/d/server-fleet-overview/windows-server-fleet-overview) · Select one **Host** above to investigate. For all servers at once, use Fleet Overview.

spec.title: CPU used
spec.description: 5-minute CPU busy time. Amber >=75%; critical >=90%.

spec.title: RAM used
spec.description: Physical memory used, based on available / total memory. Amber >=80%; critical >=90%.

spec.title: GPU 3D load
spec.description: Approximate 3D engine activity from Windows GPU performance counters, capped at 100% per adapter. Requires the optional GPU collector.

spec.title: Disk used · $volume
spec.description: Used capacity for the selected drive; amber >=80%, red >=90%. Select one host for a single-machine reading.

spec.title: Busiest NIC utilisation
spec.description: Highest interface utilisation as a percentage of its reported link speed; ignores NICs with unknown/zero bandwidth.

spec.title: Ping reachable
spec.description: Most recent ICMP probe: 1 success, 0 failed. This checks reachability, independently of Exporter.

spec.title: GPU VRAM used
spec.description: Percentage of available dedicated GPU VRAM in use, where the GPU and driver expose physical VRAM capacity. Orange >=80%, red >=95%. Integrated/shared GPUs may show No data.

spec.title: GPU temperature
spec.description: Optional hardware/driver-dependent GPU temperature. Thresholds are examples: amber >=75 °C; critical >=85 °C. Tune per GPU.

spec.title: Free disk · $volume
spec.description: Free bytes on selected drive. Select one host to see that machine. For alerting prefer per-volume minimum free bytes.

spec.title: Busiest NIC traffic
spec.description: Current receive plus transmit rate on the busiest interface in bits per second (5-minute rate).

spec.title: Exporter online
spec.description: Prometheus can scrape Windows Exporter: 1 = healthy, 0 = unavailable.

spec.title: Ping latency
spec.description: ICMP RTT in milliseconds, for successful probes only. No reading is expected while the ping check is failing.

options.content: ### RESOURCE TRENDS  ·  historical CPU, RAM and GPU performance

spec.title: CPU & RAM history
spec.description: CPU and RAM percentage over the selected time range; useful for sustained pressure vs short spikes.

spec.title: GPU 3D history
spec.description: GPU engine activity over time (optional; requires GPU collector and supported driver).

spec.title: GPU temperature history
spec.description: GPU sensor temperature over time (not available on all hardware).

options.content: ### STORAGE DETAILS  ·  per-volume capacity and read/write activity

spec.title: Disk usage by drive
spec.description: Each drive is a separate capacity bar. Amber >=80% full; critical >=90% full.

spec.title: Selected volume · $volume used vs free
spec.description: Donut aggregates the selected volume across all selected hosts. Choose one host and one volume for a single physical drive.

spec.title: Disk read/write history
spec.description: Retained for I/O spikes and workload troubleshooting, rather than as the main storage-capacity indicator.

options.content: ### NETWORK & CONNECTIVITY  ·  interface traffic, errors and probe history

spec.title: Network traffic history · received / sent
spec.description: Bits per second per NIC. Performance trend for diagnosing unusual load.

spec.title: NIC utilisation by interface
spec.description: Percentage of advertised NIC bandwidth in use (receive + transmit); can overstate full-duplex use. Amber >=70%; critical >=90%.

spec.title: NIC errors + discards (15m)
spec.description: Total Windows NIC packet errors and discards across interfaces in the past 15 minutes.

spec.title: Missed ICMP probes (24h)
spec.description: Count of observed failed probes over 24 hours, not network packet-loss percentage. No longer green when >0.

spec.title: ICMP failure rate (24h)
spec.description: Observed fraction of scheduled probes that failed over 24h. Amber >=1%; critical >=5%. Not a continuous traffic-loss measurement.

spec.title: ICMP latency history
spec.description: Round-trip latency in milliseconds from successful Blackbox ICMP probes. A failed probe is tracked above, not treated as zero-ms latency.

options.content: ### INCIDENT TIMELINE & CAPACITY WATCHLIST  ·  when did a host drop out, and which drives need attention?

spec.title: Host reachability & exporter timeline
spec.description: Continuous uptime state for the selected time window. Green = reported UP (1), red = DOWN (0). Missing samples appear as gaps, not confirmed downtime. ICMP and Exporter are independent checks.

spec.title: Fullest volumes · capacity watchlist
spec.description: Top 15 drive letters by percentage full among selected hosts. This is live capacity, not a historical maximum. Amber >=80% full; red >=90% full.
